rounds.text: The bull case relies heavily on historical profit expansion, but current performance reveals a stark deterioration evidenced by a trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth of negative 27 percent [E21]. Furthermore, the company suffers from fundamentally weak long-term expansion, having delivered a poor sales growth of only 9.83 percent over the past five years [E58]. Investors receive zero compensation for taking on these fundamental deteriorations, as the dividend yield sits firmly at 0.00 percent [E4]. Market sentiment heavily reflects these underlying risks, with the stock pinned down near the bottom of its yearly movement at just 18 percent of the way up its 52-week range [E5]. Conceded: the company maintains a P/E ratio of 15.2x alongside a 10-year compounded profit growth of 23 percent [E1, E18].
